title: Contract of the Iron Tusks
author: Captain Mazhra Redtusk
pages: Sworn over the ember, before witnesses. The Free Company of the Iron Tusks, forty riders and twenty spears, takes service with the lord of this land from Seedtide to the end of Reaping.
Pay: one silver mark per rider per month, half that per spear, and fodder, paid on Fairday. One part in three of field booty to the company. Ransoms for prisoners shared the same way.
The company will not fire temples, harm guests, or fight its own kin. If ordered to, the lord has broken the contract, and the company goes home with its pay.
If pay is late past Moot-day, the company will collect what it is owed from the lord's land, by the Ember Code, taking no more than owed and no lives that do not resist. This is law, not raiding.
Witnessed: Old Mother Shurra Emberfang, by her mark. The lord's clerk, by his seal. Mazhra Redtusk, by her own hand, which the clerk did not expect.
